checkpoint.name: Alpha 2.0 - Placement-aware sprinkler automation
checkpoint.summary: Changed Tiny Sprinkler automation from always-global random targeting to placement-focused targeting with a bounded local search for smooth performance.

implemented: Tiny Sprinkler now prefers grown tiles near its placed tile.
Unplaced sprinkler still falls back to the previous global random behavior.
Sprinkler Network searches radius 2 and still performs two touches per cycle.
The local search only runs on sprinkler ticks, not every frame.
Updated Seed Shop and world-object descriptions to explain focused watering.
performanceNotes: The local search is a bounded square: at most 9 tile checks normally or 25 checks with Sprinkler Network.
The system falls back to getRandomGrownTile only when no local grown tile is available or no sprinkler is placed.
No new persistent save shape, no new per-frame object scan, and no new rendering loop were added.

checks: Stress mode loaded with a placed sprinkler.
Waited long enough for at least one sprinkler cycle.
browserSmoke.note: Screenshot capture timed out once in the browser bridge, but app state and console checks succeeded.

knownCaveats: Sprinkler targeting is still intentionally simple: random local grown tile, no priority system yet.
If the placed sprinkler area is depleted, it falls back to global random targeting so automation does not stall.
No visual radius indicator exists yet for placement coverage.
recommendedNextSteps: Add a lightweight placement radius preview for sprinklers when selected or hovered.
Consider object-specific targeting priorities later, such as preferring dewy/lush/rare grass near the sprinkler.
Keep automation expansions tick-based and bounded; avoid full-field scans per frame.
Continue testing ?stress&perf&tiles=120 after each automation change.
